cases.name: lrgb_mono_ngc7635
cases.golden_note: Frozen floor re-cut 2026-09-08 for v5.0.4.1, one release after the v5.0.4.0 re-cut. ONE attributed cause: the auto-stretch's default sky level drops from 0.25 to 0.12. The evidence that it IS the only cause is in the diff -- `stretched` moved (8ecab0f9 -> 9a1051f4) and NOTHING else did. stacked fe52757a, noise dcf69a6e and composed 7b1b49e6 are bit-identical to v5.0.4.0, and so are all three sweeps (GHS cf23fb5c, MTF 8be5f2d8, ArcSinh d93f9aa7), because those curves do not use VeraLux's auto_tune. That is the exact opposite signature to the v5.0.4.0 re-cut, where every hash moved because the stacked pixels themselves had changed; here the stack is untouched and only the one output that reads the sky target moved. This corpus is mono (nc=1), so v5.0.4.1's other fix -- colour stacks no longer handing their synthesized luminance to PixInsight as an alpha channel -- cannot touch it, and the hashes confirm it did not. Why the change: 0.25 is the screen-autostretch convention, but a screen stretch is something you look through rather than keep. It spends a quarter of the output range on empty sky and leaves the subject on a bright grey pedestal. Measured on the composed output of four real corpora, 0.12 raises signal saturation 1.34x to 1.72x (M33 0.069->0.118, M27 2023 0.082->0.110, M27 2025 0.067->0.115, M16 dual-NB 0.473->0.691) and clips nothing at either end -- black stays 0.0000% and white is unmoved, because the shadow point is bounded independently of the sky target. It remains a user control. Do not re-cut this floor without the same kind of measurement.

cases.name: mono_lrgb_m27_2025
cases.alignment_note: 51 of 72 measured 2026-09-04. The 21 failures are the two temporal ends of a 7-hour session: chronological frames 0-19 and 66-71. Failure rate rises monotonically with distance from the reference (0-15 frames away: 31 ok / 0 failed; 32-39 away: 0 ok / 9 failed), and the reference is already the temporal midpoint, so this is cumulative tracking drift the single-reference matcher cannot bridge -- not filter, and not reference selection, which took this case from 1 of 72 to 51 of 72. Raise this floor when chained alignment lands.
cases.note: Re-enabled 2026-09-05. Phase B now carries a per-channel frame set: CacheSig gained a routing key so each mono filter gets its own cache, ShadowBuffers::n_frames is per channel, and global_frame_of maps each channel's local slot to the batch-global frame its FrameStats belong to. The golden for this case has never existed -- the previous one was deleted because it recorded three empty channels -- so it is generated fresh in this re-baseline.
